priorBlockerDisposition.basis: SW0-RC1B makes explicitly classified consequential actions structurally transactional at the application command boundary and bars legacy mutable handler registration for those actions.
SW0-RC1A adds monotonic fence_generation, fenced takeover/commit/abandon and fence validation in PostgresDomainCommitter with live PostgreSQL proof.
SW0-RC1B couples the cumulative matrix to release-index head and indexed release evidence, with mandatory cumulative proof tokens checked by scripts/check-traceability.mjs.

Fulfillment still records custody handover and acceptance without transaction-specific title/risk-transfer semantics. OPEN-011 remains intentionally externalized; no universal delivered_at rule is authorized.

PhysicalLineageLedger still accepts only one input lot per transform and derives equal output capacities from aggregate output quantity; it is not a durable general multi-input/multi-output ancestry model.

main is the verified PR #23 merge commit 7798bae250996025b82b739f06e3f806d556444a.

Consequential routing is structurally enforced only for actions declared consequential in production composition; direct domain-library calls remain available for unit tests and non-production composition.
No invariant is promoted to full GREEN by this review.
decision: The SW0 bounded kernel has cleared the three engineering blockers that prevented the prior release-candidate re-review and may proceed to the next bounded implementation phase. This is not production authorization. Production transactions remain blocked on governed transaction-specific title/risk policy (RC1-B04). Full provenance conformance remains blocked on durable explicit per-input/per-output lot lineage (RC1-B05).
next: SW0-RC2A — durable explicit multi-input/multi-output lot lineage closure for RC1-B05; keep RC1-B04 as a separate governed legal/contract policy gate rather than inventing software semantics.
